issues.t: Shudder or harsh shifts from the 8-speed automatic
issues.sym: A shake or shudder at light throttle or while slowing, clunky or loud up- and downshifts, and in some cases a transmission that slips or fails.
issues.why: The 8-speed automatic used in early XT5s can develop torque converter shudder and rough shift behavior. Owners of 2017 models report it most, sometimes within the first few thousand miles.
issues.next: Have a Cadillac dealer check for transmission software updates and fluid-related bulletins. If it slips or flares between gears, get it diagnosed before it gets worse.

issues.t: Low-speed shudder from the 9-speed automatic
issues.sym: Shaking or shuddering at low speed, jerky or delayed shifts in the lower gears, lurching, or the engine revving without the car picking up speed.
issues.why: GM bulletin 23-NA-72 covers torque converter clutch shudder on 2020-2024 XT5s. Contaminated fluid or a damaged torque converter can cause it, and some owners have needed valve body or transmission work.
issues.next: Ask a Cadillac dealer about bulletin 23-NA-72, which calls for a fluid drain and refill and a road test. If it keeps coming back or the engine flares, ask for a full transmission diagnosis while you are under warranty.

issues.t: Wrong transmission sun gear can let an axle pull out (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of drive power while driving, or the car rolling after you put it in Park.
issues.why: Some transmissions were built with the wrong sun gear, which can let the driver-side axle shaft come out of the transmission.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 23V-172 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. Use the parking brake every time you park until it is fixed.

issues.t: Front struts leaking or worn out early
issues.sym: A bouncy or floaty ride, clunking over bumps, nose dive when braking, or oily residue on the front struts.
issues.why: Owners report the front struts wearing out or leaking at around 28,000 miles on the 2017 XT5.
issues.next: Have the struts and mounts inspected. Replace them in pairs so the car handles evenly, and get an alignment afterward.

issues.t: Body control module failure
issues.sym: Electrical features acting up at once: locks, lights or accessories that stop working, warning messages, or a car that will not start normally.
issues.why: The body control module, the computer that runs many of the body electrical features, can fail on early XT5s, at around 37,000 miles on average.
issues.next: Have a shop scan all modules for codes before replacing parts. A new module has to be programmed to the car.

issues.t: Squeaking brakes
issues.sym: A squeak or squeal from the brakes, sometimes from the first miles.
issues.why: Brake squeal is the most-reported XT5 complaint on CarComplaints. It usually comes from pad vibration rather than a safety problem.
issues.next: Have the brakes checked so you know the pads and rotors are fine. New pads, shims or brake lubricant often quiet them.

issues.t: Front brake calipers can leak fluid (recall)
issues.sym: A low brake fluid warning, a soft brake pedal, or fluid on the inside of a front wheel.
issues.why: On XT5s built from April 16 to May 9, 2016, a front caliper piston seal can be torn or out of place and leak brake fluid.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 16V-802 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open.

issues.t: StabiliTrak, traction control and parking brake warnings
issues.sym: StabiliTrak, traction control, check engine and parking brake warnings coming on, sometimes with power loss or the parking brake setting by itself.
issues.why: Owners report these warnings together on early XT5s. In one documented case the brake light switch was not attached properly, which confused several systems.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Ask the shop to check the brake light switch and its mounting before replacing larger parts.

issues.t: Tires wearing out or failing early
issues.sym: Factory tires worn out at around 30,000-35,000 miles, or a sidewall blowout.
issues.why: Owners of 2018 XT5s report short tire life and at least one sidewall failure on the original 20-inch tires.
issues.next: Check tread depth and pressures monthly and keep up with rotations and alignment. Ask the tire maker about warranty coverage if they wear out early.

issues.t: Thermostat fault with Reduced Steering Assist message
issues.sym: A Steering Assist Is Reduced message, a temperature gauge that reads wrong, the cooling fan running hard, weak heat or A/C, and code P0128.
issues.why: The thermostat on the 3.6L engine can fail so the engine runs too cool. The car then sets a code and may limit features such as steering assist. RepairPal lists reduced steering assist with a faulty temperature reading as the most common XT5 problem.
issues.next: Have the code read. If P0128 is stored, replacing the thermostat usually fixes the message. Do not ignore it: a coolant problem can hide a real overheating issue.

issues.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
issues.sym: The engine quits while moving or at a stop, sometimes with every warning light on, and may restart normally afterward.
issues.why: Owners have reported stalling and sudden shutdowns on 2018 XT5s. Dealers often find no codes, so the cause can be hard to pin down.
issues.next: Pull over safely if it happens. Write down when and how it happens, and have the dealer check for software updates and open recalls.

issues.t: Water leaks inside or a noisy, dead power liftgate
issues.sym: Water on the floor or in the cargo area, electrical glitches, or a power liftgate that groans or stops working.
issues.why: GM bulletin 19-NA-167 covers 2019 XT5s with water getting inside, which can also cause electrical problems and damage the liftgate actuator.
issues.next: Find and fix the leak first, then repair any damaged wiring or the liftgate actuator. Ask the dealer about bulletin 19-NA-167.

issues.t: Service AWD warning light
issues.sym: A Service AWD message in the dash display. All-wheel drive may be switched off until it is fixed.
issues.why: GM bulletin PIE0699 tells technicians how to diagnose the Service AWD warning on the 2021 XT5.
issues.next: Have the AWD codes read at a Cadillac dealer and mention bulletin PIE0699. Avoid slippery roads until it is fixed.

issues.t: Fuel pump nozzle burr can stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine can hesitate, stall without warning, or be hard to start when the fuel is low.
issues.why: A plastic burr left from manufacturing can partly block the fuel pump jet nozzle and starve the engine of fuel.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-639 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open.

issues.t: Roof-rail airbags may not inflate properly (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. The side curtain airbags may not protect you as designed in a crash.
issues.why: The diffuser on the roof-rail airbag inflator may not have been crimped properly and could separate when it deploys.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-446 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open.

issues.t: Over-cured Continental tires can fail (recall)
issues.sym: A bulge or crack in the sidewall, sudden air loss, or tread coming apart.
issues.why: Some factory Continental tires were cured too long at the plant, which can lead to sidewall breaks or belt separation.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 20V-684 and 21V-115 and have the tires inspected and replaced free if they are affected.

issues.t: Rearview camera picture cuts out (recall)
issues.sym: The backup camera image is missing, flickers or works only some of the time on cars with Surround Vision.
issues.why: Camera cable connectors may have been crimped badly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-709 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. Check mirrors and look behind you until it is fixed.

issues.t: Fuel supply lines may leak (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell or fuel dripping under the car.
issues.why: Fuel supply lines may not have been fully seated when the car was built and can loosen and leak, which is a fire risk.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-422 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. If you smell fuel, park it outside and do not drive it.

issues.t: Fuel tank rollover valve may not seal (recall)
issues.sym: No warning in normal driving. In a rollover crash fuel could leak out.
issues.why: On some 2022 AWD models the fuel tank rollover valve may be dislodged or missing.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-446 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open.

issues.t: Left-rear toe link may come loose (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk from the left rear, wandering, or an odd feel at the rear when steering.
issues.why: The left-rear toe link bolt may not have been tightened correctly and can loosen or separate, which can cause loss of control.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-427 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. If you hear clunking from the rear, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Tire size label may be hard to read (recall)
issues.sym: The tire size and pressure information on the driver door pillar label is unreadable.
issues.why: The label may have been printed badly, so the car does not meet the federal labeling rule and the wrong tires could be fitted.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-708 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. Until then, use the owner's manual for tire size and pressure.

issues.t: Dash indicators may not light for hazards or turn signals (recall)
issues.sym: The dash does not show the indicator when the hazard lights, high beams or turn signals are on.
issues.why: An instrument panel software problem can stop these indicators from lighting.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-459 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open. The fix is a software update.

issues.t: Windshield may be missing its sealant (recall)
issues.sym: Wind noise or water leaks at the edge of the windshield, or no sign at all.
issues.why: A small number of windshields were installed without the urethane that bonds them, so the glass could come out in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 23V-681 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open.

issues.t: Driver airbag cushion may tear (recall)
issues.sym: No warning. The driver airbag may not protect you as designed in a crash.
issues.why: The driver front airbag cushion may tear when it deploys.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-311 at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer and have the free repair done if it is open.

issues.t: Glove box door does not fit right
issues.sym: The glove box door sits unevenly, rattles or does not close cleanly.
issues.why: GM preliminary bulletin PIT6416 notes glove box door fit concerns on the 2025 XT5 and told dealers to hold off on repairs while a fix was developed.
issues.next: Report it to the dealer while under warranty so it is on record, and ask whether a repair is now available.
